div.head: Had 1.2
div.ab: And se þe heom gederige mid worde oððe weorce, seofonfealdre bote gebete hit georne be þam þe seo dæd sy . . ., gif he Godes miltse geearnian wille.
⁊ se þe heom gederie mid worde oððe mid worce, seofonfealde bóte gebéte hit georne be þam þe séo dæd sy ⁊ be þam þe se hád sy, gif he Godes myltse geearnian wille.
⁊ se þe heom gederie mid worde oððe mid weorce, VIIfealdre bote gebete hit georne be þam þe seo dæd sy ⁊ be þam þe se had sy, gif he Godes mildse geearnian wylle.
Et qui eis nocebit uerbo uel opere, septies emendet secundum quod factum sit et secundum ordinem, si Dei misericordiam habere uelit.
Et propterea quisquis talibus nocere cupit aut fecit, oportet eum septupla emendatione illud emendare.
And se þe heom gederie mid worde oððe mid weorce VIIfealdre bote gebete hit georne be þam þe seo dæd sy and be þam þe se had sy gif he Godes mildse geearnian wylle.

Und wer ihnen schadet durch Wort oder durch (fehlt D) That, büsse es eifrig durch siebenfältige Busse, je nachdem die That ist, und je nachdem der Weihegrad [des Verletzten] ist, wenn er Gottes Gnade verdienen will.

And whoever harms them by word or by (lacking in D) deed, let him atone for it earnestly with sevenfold compensation, according to what the deed is and according to the grade of orders [of the injured man], if he wishes to earn God's mercy.
And he who injures them by word or deed is to atone for it eagerly with seven-fold compensation, in proportion to the deed, if he wishes to deserve God's mercy.
And he who injures them by word or deed must diligently remedy it with sevenfold compensation according to the deed and according to the order if he wishes to earn God’s favor.
